holdout.note: both scored on the SAME tag-free (leak-free) query embeddings of the fixed held-out targets; neighbor_avg is predict_from_neighbors's weighted average (production defaults, k=10) over the production neighbour pool.

acidity.reason: docs/adr/0010-body-heaviness.md: the held-out draw (repo.random_coffee_ids_for_loo, sources=(cqi,roasters_kr,shopify)) requires acidity AND body both non-null, and CQI's body is now None for every row (ADR 0010), so the held-out pool collapsed from n=200 to n=4 -- far too small to trust for a decision either way. train_attr_model.py's label-count gate alone would still ship this head (1,569 labels, above MIN_OPEN_LABELS), but ADR 0009 already established acidity underperforms the neighbour average for the open variant on a real n=200 held-out (model 1.14 vs neighbor 1.0981); this n=4 sample cannot safely overturn that, so the removal from ADR 0009 stands and the head is not shipped.
